decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the conservatory, because of its design and appearance, is considered acceptable as it relates well to its site and does not harm either the appearance of the surrounding area or the living conditions of neighbours. The development therefore complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The permission hereby granted shall be invalid should details regarding the investigation for the site shall be investigated by a competent person to identify the extent and nature of contamination. A detailed site investigation report shall be prepared and submitted to the Local Planning Authority (LPA) for comment.  The report should include a tiered risk assessment of the contamination based on the proposed end use of the site.
description: Retention of existing conservatory to existing house.
